entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name or order number to pull up the account?
The name is Alex Chen. Just tell me if I can return it or not.
Okay, one moment Mr. Chen... I see your account here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Look, it's not broken. I just find it really confusing and hard to use. I read the user manual and I just expected more from the interface. It's not for me. Can you process the return, yes or no?

Yes, absolutely. I understand completely. Let me just confirm the delivery date... I see it arrived 12 days ago. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window, so that is no problem at all.

I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. You should see it in your inbox within a few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. And, Mr. Chen, I see you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for trying out the product, I've added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase.
Okay. The credit is appreciated. I'll watch for the email.
Excellent. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
